title: The Canyon Ledger
description: Miriam Goldtongue lends money in a town that runs on it, and two debtors have gone into the canyon rather than pay. Garrett owes seventy-five gold. Selene cleared hers in one lump three weeks back and lives exactly as she did before.

objectives.description: Review the debt ledger with Miriam
Find Garrett the gambler in the canyon camps
Track down Selene the merchant in the lower canyon
Ask Selene how a cleared debt got cleared
Return to Miriam with the collected debts

notes: Soulstone-thread touchpoint per docs/design/quest_web.md row 12 (Tell 2): Selene's debt cleared in one unexplained lump sum. Never named, never explained, gates nothing. Touchpoint-only edit; rest of quest left as originally written (already STORIED).
